description: List every (spec, edition, sha, fetched_at) snapshot this server has parsed. Use to discover what historical SHAs you can query via `at: "<sha>"`, or to verify reproducibility across server versions. Optional `spec` / `edition` filters.

edition.description: Filter to one edition (concrete name like 'main' or 'es2025'). Omit for all.

spec.description: Filter to one spec. Omit for both.

name: spec.snapshots
title: List spec snapshots
